thread:
marta: Evening handoff — I'm off at 6:30 PT, taking shift notes here. Main things to watch tonight: noisy decoder tail latency spikes on eu-encoders (~p95->p99 bursts), frequent duplicate alerts from prefix-cache (same signature) and intermittent KV dropouts in us-west that correlate with autoscaler churn.

marta: Current status: primary traffic normal, no active incidents. Canary v2 rollout paused at 50% due to increased error budget on a small customer. I left the canary flag at false for EU until morning.

marta: Known noisy alerts to consider suppressing temporarily: `prefix-cache-high-rt` (same alert flapping every 1m), `kv-io-errors` (sporadic, non-impacting). See playbook: /playbooks/prefetch-and-kv.md

sam: Thanks — do you have a short grep to find the duplicate prefix alerts? I can try to filter at the alert manager level.

marta: yeah, use this to find recent instances: ```bash
grep -R "prefix-cache-high-rt" /var/log/alerts | tail -n 100
```

marta: and check grouping key: `alert.labels.instance` + `alert.annotations.signature` — duplicates have identical signature but different instance.

linh: noted. For the decoder p99 spikes, is that correlated with any model change or sequence length increases?

marta: nope, no model pushes in the last 12h. Looks like sudden tail from a small encoder worker pool (eu-encoders-03). I left a note to drain and reprovision if it looks persistent.

kai: If p99 stays > 1.2s for more than 15m, drain that node and roll a new one. Command: `kubectl drain eu-encoders-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` then scale back up.

sam: should we mute `prefix-cache-high-rt` at the alertmanager level for 30m while we investigate? Avoids paging everyone.

linh: +1 from me if we set a temporary silence and add an annotation with reason. want to avoid masking a real regression though.

marta: Go ahead — silence 30m and tag with `hand-off:evening-1723456789` and `reason: noisy duplicates`. If it spikes later with other symptoms (error budget, increased 5xx), cancel silence.

oncall-bot: Silence created: prefix-cache-high-rt for 30m by sam (silence id: s-09ab).

sam: Done. Added annotation pointing to this thread. I'll also add a Graph snapshot to the alert.

marta: For KV dropouts: watcher is `kv-health-checker`; if dropouts exceed 3/min or SLO error budget >5% open the esk escalation channel. Playbook quick checks: `curl -s http://kv-proxy:8080/health` and `redis-cli -h kv-01 latency latest`.

kai: pinged infra to check autoscaler churn logs. If autoscaler is flapping we should increase stabilization window rather than keep muting alerts.

linh: QA note — there's a scheduled batch job at 03:00 UTC that briefly increases seq lens for some tenants. Might explain nightly tail. I filed task #4521 to see if we can throttle at job window.

marta: thanks. Last bits: my pager rotation for tomorrow morning starts at 9am PT — if anything needs handoff, tag @marta and add `handoff:morning` in the thread. Otherwise, enjoy a quiet shift :)

sam: got it. I'll keep an eye and escalate if p99 persists.

kai: ack — will drain if >15m.

linh: acked and thanks for the runbook links.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: oncall checklist ping at 00:15 UTC (tomorrow).
